answer: Identity bonds decay. Each bond costs 120 units. It locks for 10 epochs. It loses 4% per epoch. Value below 60 means demotion. Real work restores face value. Faking slashes 50% of residual value. Refresh freezes for 6 epochs. A walnut shell cannot stop decay. The summit of hoarded bonds still bleeds. A velvet badge does not slow the loss. 1,000 clones cost 120,000 units. Each epoch burns 4,800 units. Ten idle epochs lose 40,000 units. Honest work is the only refill.
